sessions.title: Black Widow
sessions.summary: In Marvel Studios' action-packed spy thriller "Black Widow," Natasha Romanoff aka Black Widow confronts the darker parts of her ledger when a dangerous conspiracy with ties to her past arises. Pursued by a force that will stop at nothing to bring her down, Natasha must deal with her history as a spy and the broken relationships left in her wake long before she became an Avenger.
sessions.tagline: Her world. Her secrets. Her legacy.

sessions.summary: As Buffy gets to know a charming student named Parker, Spike searches for a ring that, according to legend, makes the wearer invincible.

sessions.title: The Jordan Boys Legacy
sessions.summary: Finding themselves on another planet, Hal and John must put aside their fractured past to solve a murder. Along their journey, both men are forced to confront the ghosts of their pasts...and the ways their childhoods shaped who they are today.

sessions.title: Permanent Uncertainty
sessions.summary: Castaways marooned in remote Fiji battle to win $1 million; one player must leave to go on a mysterious journey; the first tribal council pits two allies against each other in a dramatic battle of wills.
